source_text: De mansionibus filiorum Israel in deserto. Singulae mansiones profectus animae significant.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning stations of-sons of-Israel in desert. Individual stations of-progress of-soul signify.
pass_b_english: On [[Israel’s stations in the desert >> Bible:Numbers 33:1-49]]: each camping-place signifies a stage of the soul’s progress.
